parts.text: Good morning, friend! Wait, is it morning? Ah, doesn't matter! Anyway, please step into my office... Great, sit right here. Someone will be right with you. Just tell them you're Mitya, an expert from the Energy Commission. Got that? Okay, that's it. Bye-bye!
Ugh... I'd love to tell you some funny stories from work, but Scarf won't let me.
Did you see the show at the theater yesterday? It was pretty good. It'd be even better if I could remember what it was about...
Nochhornowls don't make a sound when they fly. One nearly snatched Scarf once... You'd better keep an eye on Paimon too!
Please don't rain, please don't rain, please don't rain... Aw, come on!
What blew up!? ...Oh, just thunder? Boring.
You have to watch out for snow that's frozen solid. Kicking it really hurts.
Hello, sun! Charge me up a little.
First thing in the morning, and yesterday's work is already staring me in the face.
Afternoon. I'll be heading to the office in a bit, so don't tell anyone I went to the theater, okay?
We sit beside the tall, tall stacks of paperwork, listening to the desk lamp tell its tales of crunch time.
Handing in paperwork this late is practically the same as handing it in tomorrow. So, tomorrow it is! Good night!

I used to love talking about my life. Then I joined the Energy Commission, and the old hands told me that anyone who doesn't want to be updating their resume in a hurry had better keep a low profile. *sigh* Trouble is, it slips my mind the second I open my mouth. Good thing I've got Scarf.

After I became a consultant to the Fatui, Valeriy warned me that the research I'm working on could change the world. Top secret and all that. I suggested he tell everyone the same thing about their work. Best place to hide a tree is in a forest, right? Then I wouldn't have to be so careful all the time. He said I've never been careful a day in my life. Is that really what he thinks of me? I'm hurt.

Do me a favor. Keep Mr. Valeriy busy for me. Half a day will do. Talk to him about anything. Ask how he's doing, treat him to a meal... If you're really out of ideas, you could always knock him flat. That works too. I've got something very, very important to do. I said that yesterday? Oh... Yeah, um, same thing — very, very important, and it still isn't finished. Right, let's both get to it!

With all the classified work I do, I'm not normally allowed to go traveling abroad whenever I like. Even signing the thickest nondisclosure agreement wouldn't change that. But Scarf proved its loyalty to the organization. They invited it to sign a form appointing it as my guardian... How weird is that? I have Scarf to thank for being free to go adventuring with you.
This thing works great. The only downside is that it won't come apart. I'm confident I could put it back exactly the way it was, but it doesn't seem to trust me much...
Wanna know the best place to cook? The office. Watching some of Snezhnaya's best and brightest figure out how to make soup with a centrifuge... Now that's amazing.

I've seen or heard of at least a dozen different kinds of fae, but the official system still lumps them into just six broad categories. Who came up with that classification system, anyway? At the Energy Association, you'd get fined for work that sloppy.
Miss Vodyanitsa is great. Really great. Lovely singing voice, and she fits right in with the theater's refined atmosphere. Exactly the kind of atmosphere I do my best work in.

Between you and me, Miss Odette might seem frosty, but she's actually easier to deal with than Vodyanitsa. Of course, maybe she just can't be bothered to tell me off. See? The world needs more generous, forgiving people like her. Hehe.

Hehe, his dogs are so well-behaved! And you can tell they're smart. Sometimes I get this urge to teach them a little science... N-No, I don't visit him just to pet his dogs! Alyosha's my friend too, you know.

If you're feeling too busy, try Mr. Valeriy's hundredth introductory lecture on time management. If you've got too much time on your hands, give it a try anyway. After all, listening to his lectures is basically killing time.

To be fair, I can't blame Mr. Valeriy for being so fixated on schedules. He's surrounded by unreliable people. They'll spot a problem and do nothing to fix it. A whole group of 'em just standing around telling each other, "Huh, strange, very strange," even as they push the work along in the wrong direction. I'm not one of them, obviously. I have no intention of pushing anything forward.

Miss Vesna's full of tricks, so she's great fun to play games with. And she's so efficient too! She can finish a whole month's work in the first ten days. Y'know, I'm going to follow her example. Only difference is, I'll leave mine until the last ten days.

Full disclosure: I once mistook Miss Danica for a whale fae. You know, something like a Frostfin Battle Whale! Cool, right? Well, I was completely wrong, and the look she gave me was pretty fierce. Miss Vesna was absolutely thrilled when she heard me say it, though. Almost fell over laughing... which worked out nicely for me, since Danica turned that glare on her instead.

Do you know what the Energy Commission said when they sent me to advise the Fatui? "Her Majesty needs energy. We need peace and quiet. That makes this a noise-pollution-reducing new energy solution." So Her Majesty doesn't want things too noisy, huh? I'll keep that in mind.

He's a good guy! I was wandering around the station once and nearly got caught by the army, and he pointed me down a back path. Scarf seemed pretty happy to see him too. Didn't even get around to tripping me, can you believe it? ...Come to think of it, whose side is this scarf even on? I really need to get it under control!
Hi, I'm Mitya. Sorry for the trouble. No trouble, you say? Don't worry. Just give it a minute.
Let's have Scarf introduce itself too. Go on, Scarf, say your lines... Sorry, Scarf's not much of a talker. I'll do it. Allow me to present my dear friend, Scarf. Please be nice to it.

My hair's naturally curly, and when I was little, it puffed out like beet leaves, so Mom always called me "Beettop." I'm not letting some secret slip, by the way! I'm just telling you ahead of time so you won't be surprised later. It's a pretty cool nickname, actually. You think so too, right?

After ten hours of working nonstop, this Beettop will be completely wilted. Remember to carry me outside and water me. If anyone tries to stop you, tell them exactly that, word for word. Most people won't be able to process it, and that's our chance to run!

The old-timers all say our line of work is pretty dangerous, so we ought to update our wills now and then. I haven't even written my first one! I did pick up a pen once, and got as far as "Dear Mom and Dad," but that didn't feel right. That's a letter home, not a will. See, when you actually need a document template, all those "meticulous" old guys suddenly go quiet. Forget it. Same as with tomorrow's work: I'll deal with it if I make it to tomorrow.
The theater, of course. Appreciating the classics. Soaking up the, uh... cultural atmosphere.
Ahh... I want to control Scarf, and I want to control when inspiration strikes. Ideally, that control would be effective round the clock.
Not too sour, not too sweet. Not too spicy, not too salty. Oh, I get it. I like averages!
My face goes bright red if I drink even a little too much. So my colleagues started using me as a human proof tester. Honestly, the things I put up with.
Whoa, this is good! One more bite... Hey, Scarf, quit wiping my mouth. I'll just have to wash you again, so why bother?
Mm-hm... I have now fully identified every component of this delicacy. Now, just wait while I go replicate it.
Uhh... You know what? Scarf would like this. Let's give it to Scarf.

Wow, congratulations! Let's celebrate the day all the good and bad in your life began! Want me to make you a little something? How about I rig you up with your very own "Scarf" helper? Just don't let it hold the handrail for you on the train. One sudden stop, and you'll be sorry.
Charged up and ready to go!
My mind's clear!
No interruptions!
I'm bursting with ideas! Wait, where's my notebook...
Over to you.
Activating default mode.
Steady now!
Pleasure working with you.
Rapid catalysis!
Reactivity monitoring engaged!
Time for a stress test!
Periodic laws... decoded.
Elemental energy, loaded.
Let's see... All inert materials. Nothing dangerous. Help yourself.
Hand me anything flammable or explosive. You can keep the rest.
Give the scarf something to hold. Keeps it busy.
I'm dying here! A little help!?
I was told it was safe here!
Hey, no fair!
Switch to power-saving mode for now.
Fine, fine, I'll do it.
If you'll... please excuse me...
Can I keep the scarf...?
Bye, all... shutting down...
Auh!?
How's that work?
What was that for...?
Hey, knock it off!
Thanks for the invite. So, uh... where are we going?
Come on, let's see what's happening in town!
Reporting in. Where's the energy crisis?
